name: kelly-products
description: E-commerce product-management desk: catalog/SKU master data, pricing, inventory, channel status (Amazon/Shopify/TikTok Shop/eBay), content readiness, compliance notes, lifecycle state, and an approval-gated review queue (channel publish approvals, price-change review, quality holds, lifecycle decisions). Products, channel rows, inventory rows, and review items enter Busabase only through the agent's own ingest workflow (see SKILL.md); the AirApp itself only ever decides on a review item (approve/request_changes/block) directly onto its own record -- it never creates a product, channel row, or inventory row.

agentPrompts: Summarize the latest Products and flag what needs my attention.
Open Kelly Products and show me the items that need review.
